releases.notes:
## v3.0.6

### Fixed

- NeoForge chunk load failures caused by a broken ChainedBlockSource constructor mixin inject
- Restore Shadow-based material rule sampling (List on 1.21.1 and below, array on 1.21.2+)
- Forge/NeoForge NoiseChunkGeneratorMixin crashes with "No refMap loaded" (keep mixin plugin + refmap together)
- Fabric jar loading via Sinytra Connector (now breaks Connector; use the native Forge/NeoForge jar)
- Modrinth/CurseForge tags mixing Minecraft ranges, incomplete game versions, and stale jars from other branches
